implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide a grid of squares with clues for across and down entries.
implemented_requirements.evidence: method `render_grid` in game.py prints the current grid with row/column indices and clue numbers; method `print_clues` prints the Across and Down clue lists.

implemented_requirements.requirement: User can enter words by specifying the clue number and direction.
implemented_requirements.evidence: method `handle_command` parses input of the form `<number> <across|down> <word>` and looks up the matching `Clue`.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Application validates if letters match the hidden solution.
implemented_requirements.evidence: method `place_word` checks length and each letter against `self.solution` and rejects mismatches.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Confirms completion when all correct words are filled in.
implemented_requirements.evidence: after a successful placement `handle_command` calls `is_complete`; if true it prints a congratulatory message and ends the game.
